Simplify a run_diff $summary_table into a compact, presentation-ready table

Source: R/run_diff.R
dot-simplify_summary_table.Rd

Called by .build_summary_table when simplify = TRUE. Strips verbose df labels (meaning moved to a footnote), formats p-values / numeric columns, compacts effect-size columns into a single "ES (95% CI)" column with symbolic metric notation, drops test_used in favour of superscript markers on p_value / p_value_adj, and line-breaks interpretation at each "; ". The table's footnotes are attached as the "df_footnote" and "pvalue_legend" attributes, rendered by as_gt.run_diff_summary.

Usage

.simplify_summary_table(
  tbl,
  n_digits_pvalues = 3,
  n_digits = 2,
  zero_as_exp = TRUE
)

Arguments

tbl

A summary_table data frame as built by .build_summary_table (pre-simplification column order).
